action.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN due_date >= DATE '2026-06-30' THEN 'current' WHEN DATE '2026-06-30' - due_date <= 30 THEN '1-30' WHEN DATE '2026-06-30' - due_date <= 60 THEN '31-60' ELSE '61+' END AS bucket, SUM(amount - amount_paid) AS outstanding FROM ar_invoices WHERE entity_id = 'CA01' AND invoice_date <= DATE '2026-06-30' AND amount - amount_paid > 0 GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY CASE bucket WHEN 'current' THEN 1 WHEN '1-30' THEN 2 WHEN '31-60' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END
